title: Frantz Fanon's birth chart
metaDescription: Frantz Fanon's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 27.4° Cancer. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: Four of the nine placements whose signs are settled stand in Leo — Mercury, Venus, Mars and Neptune. The placements whose signs could change with an unknown hour are not counted. A cluster that size becomes the section the rest of the chart plays around.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: The Sun's position resolves to 27.4° Cancer — deep enough in the third decan (20°–30°) that Jupiter, its traditional sub-ruler, colours the reading.

blocks.title: The personal registers
blocks.text: The personal planets sit Mercury at 23.2° Leo, Venus at 20.8° Leo, Mars at 15.3° Leo. Mercury in a fire sign reads as thought that arrives already in motion; Venus in a fire sign reads as attraction declared rather than implied; Mars in a fire sign reads as effort spent in bursts and openings.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: Venus to Neptune is the closest call of the day, a conjunction within 0.6°. The tradition stops reading a conjunction as two things. It is one appetite with two names, and it moves together or not at all. Behind it, Mercury conjunction Neptune at 1.8°, and the Sun trine Uranus at 2.1° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. The unknown hour cannot unmake any of this: every aspect named survived all twenty-five samples of the day.

blocks.title: Figures in the geometry
blocks.text: No closed figure — no grand trine, t-square, or grand cross — holds among the day-stable angles. The chart distributes its tension pair by pair rather than through one standing structure.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: The oldest layer of the scheme — seven planets, four conditions — flags a single placement in this chart. Jupiter in Capricorn at 16.3° is in fall — the tradition’s uphill placement, strength earned rather than given. The table describes circumstance rather than quality — a planet in detriment is inconvenienced, not diminished.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: Of the 9 placements whose signs hold for the whole day: 4 in water, 4 in fire, 1 in earth by element, 5 fixed, 3 cardinal, 1 mutable by modality. A water emphasis reads as porousness: the room is registered whole, long before it is analysed in parts. No settled placement falls in air — an absence the tradition treats as information, not as a defect. Jupiter and Uranus were retrograde — the optical reversal the tradition reads as review — energy turned over before it is turned out.

blocks.title: The Moon is genuinely open
blocks.text: The Moon crossed from Cancer into Leo during that day at the birthplace, travelling 11.8° between one midnight and the next. A birth time would settle it in a second; there isn’t one. So the Moon stays unnamed here — the alternative is a guess wearing the clothes of a fact.
